example.title: Rustic Bridge, Old Beechwold Historic District

brief: Rustic stone arch bridge of the early 1900s on a residential street: a single semicircular arch of rough split fieldstone voussoirs in random-rubble spandrels, topped by a rubble parapet with an irregular 'rustic' crenellated top of upright stones, carrying a narrow lane through a wooded ravine in a leafy historic neighbourhood. (Inventory span 0 m: this and SMALL-30 sit at the same spot, a mill-race crossing in the village.)

traits.railing_detail: rustic rubble parapet with upright-stone top
